facts.fact: Officials of Liberia, Sierra Leone and Guinea, with TRANSCO CLSG and consultancy TACTIS, reached consensus at an Abidjan workshop on a regional consortium of licensed operators and a roadmap to operationalise excess fibre capacity on the TRANSCO CLSG network, including terrestrial redundancy links for Liberia through Cote d'Ivoire and Guinea, before end-2026; the document gives no workshop date, so its published date of 2026-06-16 is used.
